name: Galileo (galileo.ai) (now Splunk Agent Observability)
desc: Acquired by Cisco (announced 2026-04-09, closed by 2026-05); now Splunk Agent Observability. Treats memory as first-class in multi-agent tracing. Luna-2 SLMs (3B / 8B) scan every interaction for intent drift and belief drift; 20+ checks at sub-200ms latency. Catches when agent A's view of the world splits from teammate B's. OpenTelemetry-compatible.
deployment: SaaS cloud; Enterprise: VPC or on-prem
pricing: Standalone pricing retired — galileo.ai/pricing now redirects to Splunk pricing; sold as Splunk Agent Observability

name: LangSmith
desc: Memory reads, vector DB retrievals, state changes are distinct span types in traces. RAG eval separates retrieval quality (context precision) from generation quality (faithfulness). Dataset versioning guards against eval drift.
pricing: Developer: free (5K traces/mo); Plus: $39/seat/mo (10K traces); Enterprise: custom (SSO/SAML; dedicated support)
type: Memory mutations as distinct span types

name: Langfuse
desc: Part of ClickHouse since Jan 2026; product and MIT-licensed repo continue under the Langfuse name. Memory module reads/writes captured as named spans. Trace Log View concatenates every agent step including memory ops. Agent Graphs (GA 2025) infer graph structure from observation nesting; session-level replay tracks how memory state evolves.
deployment: SaaS cloud (Berlin + SF) or self-hosted Docker/K8s; ClickHouse native integration post-acquisition
pricing: free: 50K observations/mo; Pro: $59/mo; Team: $199/mo; Enterprise: custom
license: MIT (core; ee/ directories under separate enterprise license)
type: Memory ops as named spans + Agent Graphs

name: Ratine
desc: Only tool found that scans the persistent memory layer on disk rather than runtime tracing. Detects injected instructions, obfuscated payloads (zero-width Unicode, base64, homoglyphs, hex), C2-pattern URLs, credential leakage. ratine diff compares snapshots for belief drift.
deployment: local CLI — Python; pip install; no server required
pricing: free / open source (MIT); no paid tier

name: Amplenote
desc: Tags + bidirectional links + task/calendar integration. "Task Score" priority matrix. AmpleAI plugin supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama.

name: Apple Notes + Apple Intelligence
desc: Folder + tag hierarchy; iCloud sync. Writing Tools (proofread / rewrite / summarise) across all note content; audio transcription + AI summary; smart search; reminders from to-dos.

name: CORE (RedPlanet)
desc: Always-on 'personal AI OS' that indexes email, meetings, GitHub, Linear, Slack and assistant chats into a temporal knowledge graph with fact classification and intent-driven retrieval, plus MCP integrations. Traction: ~2k stars; reports 88.24% on LoCoMo (vendor claim)

name: Capacities
desc: Object-graph (people, books, projects as typed objects); daily notes; bidirectional links. AI chat grounded in current note; AI property auto-fill; in-editor writing assistant; pattern-finding across objects.
pricing: Basic free; Pro $9.99/mo (16% off yearly); Believer from $12.49/mo; AI Plus add-on $8.33/mo (annual)

name: Craft AI
desc: Hierarchical block-based documents + nested pages (no native graph). In-document AI assistant: summarise, rewrite, translate, Q&A over docs, proofread.
pricing: Free; Plus $8/mo ($6.40/mo annual); Family $15/mo (2–6 accounts); Team $50/mo (up to 10 Plus accounts)

name: Heptabase
desc: Visual whiteboard canvas + nested cards + bidirectional links + journal. AI chat with cited sources inside whiteboards; supports OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic backends.
type: Visual whiteboard + cards + AI chat with citations

name: Heyday
desc: AI assistant that builds a searchable memory from meetings (Zoom app), emails, documents, notes and web reading; answers questions, prepares client context and drafts content. Now marketed mainly to coaches and knowledge workers.
pricing: $19/mo (monthly) or $179/yr (annual) — browser extension AI research assistant

name: Logseq
desc: Open-source local-first outliner. Notes stored as Markdown / Org-mode on disk. AI integration via community plugins (e.g. logseq-ai for chatting with the graph). Graph view + backlinks; daily-journal-driven workflow.
deployment: Both (desktop app local-first; optional sync add-on planned)
pricing: Free (open-source; all local features free; future Logseq Pro cloud sync planned as paid)

name: Mem.ai
desc: Note-taking with no folders; AI-chat over notes. Focused on connections between notes rather than hierarchy.

name: Microsoft Recall
desc: Windows-native screen-recording memory. Continuously indexes activity across apps, documents, browsing; timeline UI for revisiting work. Distinct from Copilot Memory.
deployment: On-device (snapshots stored locally on Copilot+ PCs)

name: Mymind
desc: No tags, no folders, no manual organisation. Automatic image tagging, OCR search inside screenshots/memes, smart auto-grouping (Smart Spaces), semantic search. Privacy-first.
pricing: Bookmarker $4.99/mo; Student of Life $7.99/mo or $79/yr; Mastermind $12.99/mo or $129/yr; Newton $299/yr (not yet available)

name: Notion AI
desc: Notion's first-party AI. Reads up to 50 pages per query (as of Jan 2026); Custom Instructions persist brand voice / team structure / preferences. Context follows you across model swaps. Notably not persistent cross-session learning — it organises and summarises what's in Notion rather than learning from interactions.

name: Obsidian Smart Connections
desc: Obsidian community plugin. Generates embeddings locally with a bundled model (TaylorAI/bge-micro-v2, 384-dim); chat with notes + see semantically related links. No API key required for local; supports 100+ cloud models optionally. Privacy-first.
deployment: Both (local-first plugin; optional cloud LLM APIs)
pricing: Free core plugin; Pro (all-access) subscription — 14-day free trial then paid

name: Personal.ai
desc: AI memory platform sold to telecom carriers: memory, identity and on-network inference that turn each subscriber identity on the network into an agent (products: My AI, Persona Studio, Memory Core; MODEL-4).
deployment: Deployed on the operator's own network (carrier on-prem)
pricing: No public pricing — sales-led single agreement per operator (deployment, licensing, support)

name: Reflect
desc: Daily-notes + backlinks note app now relaunched as Reflect Open: open-source, offline-first, notes stored as local Markdown files synced via iCloud or Git; optional AI with your own API key. Reflect Classic still maintained.
deployment: Local-first (Markdown files on device; Mac/iPhone/iPad); Classic remains managed
pricing: Reflect Open: Mac app free; iPhone/iPad paid subscription (App Store); AI via own API key

name: RemNote AI
desc: Hierarchical outline + bidirectional links + spaced-repetition flashcards. AI auto-generates flashcards/quizzes from notes; AI summaries; fill-gap questions.
pricing: Free; Pro $8/mo ($96/yr); Pro with AI $18/mo ($216/yr); lifetime option

name: Saner.ai
desc: Auto-tagged flat notes; semantic clusters (no folders). "Skai" personal AI surfaces related notes, semantic search, cross-tool integration (Drive, Slack, Calendar). ADHD-focused.
pricing: Free (30 AI requests/mo, 100 notes); Starter $8/mo (30 AI req/day, 1K notes); Standard $16/mo (unlimited notes, 100 AI req/day); ~20% off yearly

name: Screenpipe
desc: Local-first 24/7 screen and audio recorder that indexes what you see/hear and exposes it as context/memory to AI agents (MCP, API); open-source Rewind/Recall alternative. Traction: ~22k GitHub stars; Y Combinator S26

name: Scrintal
desc: Infinite whiteboard + bidirectional-linked cards (spatial + networked hybrid). AI assistant for brainstorming, summarisation, rewriting selected cards.
pricing: Free; Pro $9/mo (annual) — from product claims row

name: Second Me (Mindverse)
desc: Open-source system for training a local 'AI self' from your own notes and memories using hierarchical memory modelling, deployable as a personal agent on a network of Second Mes. Traction: ~15.7k GitHub stars; #12 in TeleAI Awesome-Agent-Memory

name: Supernotes AI
desc: Flat notecards + tags + collections; bidirectional references. AI tag recommendations, grammar suggestions, Vision (notecard editing assistant), Collection Creator.
pricing: Starter free (100 cards); Unlimited £6/mo or £72/yr (25% off); 4-year plan 50% off

name: Tana (now Tana Outliner)
desc: Tana split in Mar 2026: the supertag-based outliner/PKM is now 'Tana Outliner' at outliner.tana.inc, while tana.inc is a separate agentic meeting platform sharing a knowledge graph. Outliner keeps Tana AI on nodes (chat with notes, summaries, automations).
pricing: Tana Outliner: Free (500 AI credits); Plus $8/mo; Pro $14/mo (yearly saves 22%). Meetings product: Free; Pro ~$20–30; Business from $35/user/mo

name: Tencent ima.copilot
desc: Tencent's knowledge-management productivity AI, powered by Hunyuan. Copilot mode adds a four-module persistent memory architecture: Soul (agent persona), User (profile), Memory (long-term declarative), Agent (learned skills/task experience). Memory persists across devices and sessions; context awareness reads active web pages and files automatically.

name: AWS Bedrock AgentCore Memory
desc: AWS managed memory service for agents running on Bedrock AgentCore. Native integrations with LangChain/LangGraph and Strands. Drives long-running MCP servers + agent workloads.
pricing: Pay-per-use: short-term $1.00/GB ingested (was $0.25/1k events until 2026-10-05) + $0.10/GB-mo storage; long-term $0.75/1k records-mo (built-in) and $0.50/1k re

name: Anthropic Claude Memory
desc: Memory tool API + consumer "Memory" feature + Auto Dream consolidation. Document-as-memory rather than extracted-fact-as-memory.

name: Anthropic Managed Agents — Memory
desc: Public-beta memory stores for Claude Managed Agents: workspace-scoped collections of text documents mounted into the session sandbox as a directory the agent reads and writes with its file tools; every change is versioned for audit and point-in-time restore, and memories can also be managed via API/Console.
pricing: Claude API token rates + $0.08 per session-hour for Managed Agents

name: Cloudflare Agent Memory
desc: Managed persistent memory service for AI agents on Cloudflare's edge. Beta-launched April 2026. Sits alongside Workers AI / Vectorize as the memory tier of the Cloudflare agent stack.
pricing: Free during private beta (not billed; Cloudflare promises 30 days' notice before charging)

name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Memory Bank (rebrand of Vertex AI Memory Bank)
desc: GA at Google Cloud Next 2026 (2026-04-22). Vertex AI rebranded as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; Memory Bank now "Agent Platform Memory Bank" with new continuous event-streaming + automated memory generation triggered by configurable criteria (event count or idle time). Backed by Agent Runtime that supports long-running agents that maintain state for days. Note: separate "Memory Profiles" featu
deployment: Managed cloud (GCP); on-prem option via open-source Gemma 4
pricing: Pay-per-use; Memory Bank compute metered on the Agent Platform compute SKU from 2026-09-01, plus embedding-model SKUs
type: Long-running agent memory with continuous event-streaming consolidation

name: Google Gemini Memory
desc: Gemini app learns from past chats via the Personal context setting (on by default, can be disabled; temporary chats excluded). Users can import memories and full chat history from ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants (18+, personal accounts, not EEA/CH/UK).
pricing: Free; Google AI Pro $20/mo; AI Ultra $100/mo and $200/mo tiers (US, May 2026)

name: Grok Memory (xAI)
desc: Extracts and persists facts from past conversations; applies them to future responses. Per-memory deletion UI; user can also clear all.

name: LinkedIn Cognitive Memory Agent
desc: Production memory infrastructure powering LinkedIn's Hiring Assistant and other GenAI apps. Three-layer (episodic/semantic/procedural) shared memory substrate across multi-agent systems; recent-context retrieval + semantic search + summarisation-based compaction. April 2026.

name: Meta AI Memory
desc: Meta AI remembers details users share in 1:1 chats (or asks it to remember) and uses them to personalise later replies; memory launched in Facebook, Messenger and WhatsApp in the US and Canada, with separate personalised responses drawing on Facebook and Instagram account info. Group chats are excluded.
pricing: Meta AI free; Meta One Core $7.99/mo and Premium $19.99/mo add more AI generation capacity (memory not tier-gated per announcement)

name: Microsoft Copilot Memory
desc: Microsoft 365 Copilot memory (saved memories, chat-history details, custom instructions) stored in a hidden folder of the user's Exchange mailbox under mailbox compliance; on by default, admin-controllable; available to Copilot Chat users with or without an M365 Copilot licence. Docs still label it preview.

name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service Memory
desc: Fully managed long-term memory store built into Azure/Microsoft Foundry Agent Service that extracts user-profile facts and chat summaries and retrieves them across sessions — Microsoft's peer to AgentCore Memory and Vertex Memory Bank. Traction: Major-vendor launch (Microsoft Ignite 2025); InfoQ coverage Feb 2026

name: Mistral Agents API
desc: Mistral's Agents API provides persistent conversation state across turns and sessions; runtime maintains branching conversation trees. Memory is implicit in the stateful session model rather than a separate store — agents can branch, continue prior discussions, and accumulate tool-call history without manual tracking.
deployment: Managed cloud (la Plateforme) + self-hosted Docker on-prem + Mistral Forge enterprise
pricing: API pay-per-token (e.g. Mistral Large $0.5 in / $1.5 out per 1M tokens; batch -50%); enterprise custom

name: Mistral Le Chat — Memories (now Vibe)
desc: Le Chat was renamed Vibe (reported 2026-05-28). Memories in Mistral's consumer assistant: saves details on user request or automatically; user can view/edit/delete or clear all; beta, retained for subscription duration, may be used for training unless opted out.
deployment: Managed-only (Le Chat) + self-hosted (open weights models) + private cloud via enterprise
pricing: Free; Pro $14.99/mo; Education $5.99/mo; Team $24.99/user/mo; Enterprise custom

name: OpenAI ChatGPT Memory
desc: First-party ChatGPT memory combining saved memories, reference to past chats, custom instructions and connected apps; 'improved memory' keeps an evolving summary (legacy list-style saved memories still selectable), with review/correct/delete controls and temporary chats.

name: Perplexity Brain
desc: Topic-organised shared memory layer under Perplexity Search, the Computer agent and possibly Comet; stores projects, decisions and sources, retrieves selectively per task, and exposes topics plus a 3D connection map to the user. Traction: Major-vendor announcement; Perplexity claims +25% correctness, +16% recall, -13% cost on context-dependent tasks

name: Perplexity Memory
desc: Stores preferences and details (and optionally search history) to personalize answers, citing which memory was used; user controls in Settings → Memory. 'Brain' adds structured self-improving memory for Max subscribers and shared project Brains in Computer; Enterprise memories are org-owned and admin-managed.

name: Vertex AI Memory Bank (now Agent Platform Memory Bank)
desc: Google Cloud managed memory service, now 'Agent Platform Memory Bank' in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. LLM-based memory extraction/consolidation from sessions (background, multimodal, custom topics), per-identity isolation, similarity search, TTL, revisions; used from ADK via VertexAiMemoryBankService.

name: Adaptive-RAG
desc: Smaller classifier LM predicts query complexity, then routes to no-retrieval / single-step / iterative retrieval as appropriate. NAACL 2024.

name: Atlas
desc: Meta AI. Jointly fine-tunes retriever + LM for few-shot tasks.

name: AutoRAG
desc: Applies AutoML to RAG: greedy algorithm evaluates and selects best-performing module at each pipeline stage (query expansion, retrieval, reranking, generation). Validated on ARAGOG (423 papers, 107 QAs).

name: BGE-M3
desc: Single embedding model supporting dense, sparse, and multi-vector (ColBERT-style) retrieval simultaneously. 100+ languages, inputs up to 8192 tokens. Self-knowledge distillation across the three modes.

name: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory
desc: Argues standard RAG breaks on bounded agent conversation streams (highly correlated, redundant spans). Decomposes the stream into semantic units, organises them into themes, then inverts that structure for retrieval.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: CAG (Cache-Augmented Generation)
desc: "Don't Do RAG." Preloads all relevant documents into context, caches the resulting KV state; at inference the model answers from cache with no retrieval step — eliminates retrieval latency + retrieval-error failure modes.

name: CRAG
desc: Lightweight retrieval evaluator scores docs and triggers different actions: use, supplement with web search, or discard. Decompose-then-recompose algorithm filters irrelevant content from retrieved passages.

name: ChunkRAG
desc: Semantic chunking divides documents into coherent sections; LLM-based relevance scorer filters each chunk against the query before generation, pruning irrelevant chunks and reducing hallucination.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
